relationships.subject: oxaliplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: The response to AITC increased in the presence of oxaliplatin in a concentration-dependent manner

relationships.subject: hiPSC-derived sensory neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Cultured sensory neurons exhibited gene expression of the Nav1.7, TRPV1, TRPA1, and TRPM8 channels

key_findings: hiPSC-derived sensory neurons on MEA express pain channels and respond to capsaicin, AITC and menthol and to temperature.
Oxaliplatin enhanced AITC responses, reproducing cold hypersensitivity in vitro.
